POSE_1: ISSUE - Spine hyper-extended, limbs splayed unnaturally.
POSE_2: OK - Balanced crouch, limbs positioned for landing.
POSE_3: ISSUE - Extreme spinal flexion, limbs contorted.
POSE_4: ISSUE - Neck/Spine bent at impossible angle, legs folded incorrectly.
POSE_5: ISSUE - Limbs tangled, spine compressed awkwardly.
POSE_6: OK - Upright posture, balanced stance, natural limb alignment.
